_comment: Canonical, cross-stack contract for the AI request types the iOS client sends through the claudeProxy Cloud Function. This is the single source of truth (P3-02). Both stacks are asserted against it: functions/test/contract.test.ts reads THIS file and requires ALLOWED_REQUEST_TYPES + SYSTEM_PROMPTS + MODEL_CONFIG to match exactly; ios AIRequestTypeContractTests.swift pins AIRequestType.allCases to the same list. Adding/renaming/removing a type requires editing this file AND both stacks, or a test fails. nightly_report is intentionally EXCLUDED — it is a scheduled-job-only prompt and must never be client-callable.
